prompt: Build the Chinese internet meme character 大笑奶龙 (Laughing Nailong, also called 奶蛙) in 3D with three.js from memory, as it appears in the meme. No reference image is provided. Task (3D, static, from memory): write an HTML page that builds the character from code and renders it from your reference camera. For this static task, render(t) may ignore t. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. Import from 'three' and from 'three/addons/'; the only addons available are 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ConvexGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricFunctions.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js', 'three/addons/math/ConvexHull.js', 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'. Use one
html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>大笑奶龙</title>
<style>
html,body{width:240px;height:240px;margin:0;overflow:hidden;background:#fff6e4}
canvas{display:block;width:240px;height:240px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xfff6e4);
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(240, 240);
renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.18;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

function material(color, roughness = .61) {
  return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color, roughness, side: THREE.DoubleSide });
}
const skin = material(0xffca24);
const belly = material(0xffe8a0);
const soles = material(0xffb922);
const ridge = material(0xf29b26);
const eyeInk = material(0x382018);
const mouthInk = material(0x551d21);
const lip = material(0xe89a20);
const tonguePink = material(0xf67c7e, .5);
const teeth = material(0xfff5d9);
const sphere = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 48, 32);

function group(parent, name, x = 0, y = 0, z = 0) {
  const part = new THREE.Group();
  part.name = name;
  part.position.set(x, y, z);
  parent.add(part);
  return part;
}
function ellipsoid(parent, name, mat, x, y, z, a, b, c) {
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(sphere, mat);
  mesh.name = name;
  mesh.position.set(x, y, z);
  mesh.scale.set(a, b, c);
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}
function surface(parent, name, mat, nu, nv, point, reverse = false) {
  const positions = [], indices = [];
  for (let j = 0; j <= nv; ++j) {
    for (let i = 0; i <= nu; ++i) positions.push(...point(i / nu, j / nv));
  }
  for (let j = 0; j < nv; ++j) {
    for (let i = 0; i < nu; ++i) {
      const a = j * (nu + 1) + i, b = a + 1;
      const c = a + nu + 1, d = c + 1;
      if (reverse) indices.push(a,c,b,b,c,d);
      else indices.push(a,b,c,b,d,c);
    }
  }
  const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geometry.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
  geometry.setIndex(indices);
  geometry.computeVertexNormals();
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, mat);
  mesh.name = name;
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}
function stroke(parent, name, mat, points, radius, endRadius = radius) {
  const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points.map(p => new THREE.Vector3(...p)));
  const frames = curve.computeFrenetFrames(40, false);
  surface(parent, name, mat, 12, 40, (u,v) => {
    const i = Math.round(v * 40), angle = u * Math.PI * 2;
    const r = endRadius + (radius - endRadius) * Math.pow(Math.sin(Math.PI*v), .55);
    return curve.getPointAt(v)
      .addScaledVector(frames.normals[i], r * Math.cos(angle))
      .addScaledVector(frames.binormals[i], r * Math.sin(angle)).toArray();
  });
  for (const p of [points[0], points.at(-1)]) {
    ellipsoid(parent, name + ' end', mat, ...p, endRadius, endRadius, endRadius);
  }
}

const nailong = group(scene, 'character-laughing-nailong');
const torso = group(nailong, 'torso', 0, 1.04, -.12);
ellipsoid(torso, 'round body', skin, 0, 0, 0, .83, .91, .65);
surface(torso, 'cream belly', belly, 64, 30, (u,v) => {
  const a = u * 2 * Math.PI;
  const x = .59 * v * Math.cos(a) * (1 - .13 * Math.sin(a) * v);
  const y = -.12 + .68 * v * Math.sin(a);
  const z = .65 * Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - (x/.83)**2 - (y/.91)**2));
  return [x,y,z + .009];
}, true);

const tail = group(nailong, 'tail', 0, .69, -.51);
surface(tail, 'curled tapered tail', skin, 48, 46, (u,v) => {
  const a = u * 2 * Math.PI;
  const r = .40 * Math.pow(1-v, .76);
  return [
    .23*v*v + Math.cos(a)*r,
    -.16*Math.sin(Math.PI*v) + .39*v*v + Math.sin(a)*r*.82,
    -1.11*v + .11*v*v
  ];
});
for (const [y,z,h] of [[1.63,-.67,.18],[1.32,-.76,.15],[1.01,-.77,.13],[.72,-1.04,.11],[.66,-1.34,.085]]) {
  const scute = ellipsoid(nailong, 'rounded dorsal scale', ridge, 0,y,z,.12,h,.13);
  scute.rotation.x = -.31;
}

for (const s of [-1,1]) {
  const side = s === -1 ? 'left' : 'right';
  const leg = group(nailong, side + ' leg', s*.46,.42,-.04);
  ellipsoid(leg,'ankle',skin,0,0,0,.31,.36,.32);
  const foot = group(leg,'foot',s*.06,-.18,.19);
  foot.rotation.y = s*.18;
  ellipsoid(foot,'rounded foot',soles,0,0,0,.355,.23,.46);
  for (let i = -1; i <= 1; ++i) {
    ellipsoid(foot,'toe',soles,i*.13,-.045,.30,.115,.125,.155-Math.abs(i)*.025);
  }
  const arm = group(nailong, side + ' arm', s*.68,1.38,.13);
  const upper = ellipsoid(arm,'upper arm',skin,s*.07,-.12,.09,.225,.38,.225);
  upper.rotation.z = s*.43;
  upper.rotation.x = -.51;
  const hand = group(arm, 'hand', s*.11,-.28,.31);
  hand.rotation.z = -s*.27;
  ellipsoid(hand,'palm',skin,0,0,0,.205,.22,.19);
  ellipsoid(hand,'thumb',skin,-s*.135,.035,.075,.104,.119,.11);
  for (let i = -1; i <= 1; ++i) {
    ellipsoid(hand,'finger',skin,i*.092,-.12,.085,.077,.106,.095);
  }
}

const head = group(nailong, 'head', 0, 2.31,.05);
head.rotation.x = -.075;
head.rotation.z = -.055;
const height = .985;
function width(y) {
  return 1.145 * (1 - .135*y + .035*Math.exp(-((y+.24)**2)/.064));
}
function center(y) {
  return .035 - .135*y + .10*Math.exp(-((y+.34)**2)/.14);
}
function front(x,y) {
  return center(y) + .86*Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,1-(y/height)**2-(x/width(y))**2));
}
const mouthWidth = .805;
function mouthBounds(x) {
  const a = Math.min(1,Math.abs(x)/mouthWidth);
  const span = Math.sqrt(1-a*a);
  const mid = -.33 + .28*a*a;
  return [mid - .292*span, mid + .168*span];
}
function hollow(x,y) {
  if (Math.abs(x) >= mouthWidth) return 0;
  const [bottom, top] = mouthBounds(x);
  const v = (y-bottom)/(top-bottom);
  if (v <= 0 || v >= 1) return 0;
  return .146 * Math.pow(Math.sin(Math.PI*v), .72) *
    Math.pow(1-(x/mouthWidth)**2,.65);
}
surface(head, 'cheeks and skull', skin, 168, 112, (u,v) => {
  const a = u * Math.PI * 2, t = v * Math.PI;
  const y = height * Math.cos(t), wave = Math.sin(t);
  const x = width(y) * wave * Math.cos(a);
  const z = center(y) + .86 * wave * Math.sin(a);
  return [x,y,z-(Math.sin(a)>0 ? hollow(x,y) : 0)];
});

const mouth = group(head, 'open laughing mouth');
surface(mouth, 'mouth interior', mouthInk, 96, 48, (u,v) => {
  const x = mouthWidth * -Math.cos(Math.PI*u);
  const [bottom,top] = mouthBounds(x);
  const y = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(bottom,top,v);
  return [x,y,front(x,y)-hollow(x,y)+.009];
});
for (const upper of [true,false]) {
  const points = Array.from({length:33}, (_,i) => {
    const x = -.800*Math.cos(Math.PI*i/32);
    const y = mouthBounds(x)[upper ? 1 : 0];
    return [x,y,front(x,y)+.004];
  });
  stroke(mouth, upper ? 'upper smile edge' : 'lower smile edge', lip, points, .021,.011);
}
surface(mouth, 'upper teeth', teeth, 64, 10, (u,v) => {
  const x = (2*u-1)*.673;
  const [,top] = mouthBounds(x);
  const depth = .061*Math.pow(Math.sin(Math.PI*u),.62);
  const y = top-.015-depth*v;
  return [x,y,front(x,y)-hollow(x,y)+.020];
}, true);
const tongue = group(mouth, 'tongue');
surface(tongue, 'rounded pink tongue', tonguePink, 66, 22, (u,v) => {
  const x = (2*u-1)*.462 + .032;
  const lobe = Math.pow(Math.sin(Math.PI*u),.64);
  const [bottom] = mouthBounds(x);
  const y = bottom+.018 + v*lobe*(.176-.023*Math.exp(-((x-.03)**2)/.003));
  return [x,y,front(x,y)-hollow(x,y)+.022+.045*Math.sin(Math.PI*v)*lobe];
});

for (const s of [-1,1]) {
  const eye = group(head, s < 0 ? 'left laughing eye' : 'right laughing eye');
  const outline = [[.19,.135],[.29,.231],[.414,.288],[.545,.258],[.67,.135]];
  stroke(eye,'squeezed eyelid',eyeInk,outline.map(([x,y])=>[s*x,y,front(s*x,y)+.015]),.049,.024);
}
const nose = group(head,'snout');
ellipsoid(nose,'rounded muzzle tip',skin,0,.077,front(0,.077)-.018,.228,.110,.102);
for (const s of [-1,1]) {
  const nostril = ellipsoid(nose,'nostril',lip,s*.096,.103,front(0,.077)+.073,.024,.013,.009);
  nostril.rotation.z = s*.25;
}

const floor = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(200,200),material(0xfff0d8));
floor.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2;
floor.position.y = -.025;
scene.add(floor);
const shadowMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0x9a5b31,transparent:true,opacity:.035,depthWrite:false});
for (let i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
  const f = 1-i/21;
  const shadow = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CircleGeometry(1,64),shadowMat);
  shadow.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2;
  shadow.position.set(0,-.022+i*.00015,-.15);
  shadow.scale.set(1.26*f,.76*f,1);
  scene.add(shadow);
}
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfffaf0,0xffddb1,2.10));
function light(color,intensity,x,y,z) {
  const key = new THREE.DirectionalLight(color,intensity);
  key.position.set(x,y,z);
  scene.add(key);
}
light(0xfff5e0,2.45,-3,5,4);
light(0xffe1ae,1.55,2,4,-4);
light(0xfffbf2,.62,4,1,3);

const ref = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1.94,1.94,1.94,-1.94,.1,50);
ref.position.set(1.45,2.65,8);
ref.lookAt(0,1.64,0);
function render(t) {
  renderer.render(scene,ref);
}
render(0);
window.nwb = {scene,renderer,cameras:{ref},characters:[nailong],render,ready:true};
</script>
</body>
</html>
